children.name: Trachydoras microstomus
children.description: Trachydoras microstomus is a species of thorny catfish that is native to Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana, Peru and Venezuela.

children.name: Trachydoras paraguayensis
children.description: Trachydoras paraguayensis is a species of thorny catfish found in the Paraná River basin of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil and Paraguay.

children.name: Megalodoras guayoensis
children.description: Megalodoras guayoensis is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Venezuela where it occurs in the Orinoco River basin.

children.name: Megalodoras uranoscopus
children.description: The giant talking catfish or giant raphael catfish (Megalodoras uranoscopus) is a species of thorny catfish that is native to the Amazon Basin in Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.

children.name: Anadoras weddellii
children.description: thumb|right|alt=Drawing of Anadoras weddellii fish.|Drawing of Anadoras weddellii fish Anadoras weddellii is a species of thorny catfish that is found in Argentina, Brazil, Bolivia and Paraguay.

children.name: Anadoras grypus
children.description: Anadoras grypus is a species of thorny catfish found in the upper Amazon basin of Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, and Bolivia.

children.name: Doras carinatus
children.description: Doras carinatus is a species of thorny catfish found in Brazil, French Guiana, Guyana, Suriname and Venezuela.

children.name: Hemidoras stuebelii
children.description: Hemidoras stuebelii, the Maranon thorn catfish, is a species of thorny catfish from the family Doradidae which is found in the Amazon Basin in Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.

children.name: Scorpiodoras heckelii
children.description: Scorpiodoras heckelii is a species of thorny catfish from the Negro, Orinoco and upper Amazon basins in Brazil and Venezuela.

children.name: Scorpiodoras bolivarensis
children.description: Scorpiodoras bolivarensis is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Venezuela where it is found in the Orinoco River basin.

children.name: Tenellus trimaculatus
children.description: Tenellus trimaculatus is a species of thorny catfish native to Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Peru and Venezuela.

children.name: Tenellus leporhinus
children.description: Tenellus leporhinus is a species of thorny catfish native to Brazil, Guyana and Venezuela where it is found in the Orinoco, Branco, Trombetas and Essequibo River basina.

children.name: Tenellus cristinae
children.description: Tenellus cristinae is a species of thorny catfish native to the Amazon basin where it can be found in Brazil, Colombia and Peru.

children.name: Agamyxis pectinifrons
children.description: Agamyxis pectinifrons, the spotted talking catfish, spotted raphael catfish or whitebarred catfish, is a species of thorny catfish found in the Amazon basin where it has been recorded from Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru.

children.name: Acanthodoras depressus
children.description: Acanthodoras depressus is a species of thorny catfish found in the upper Orinoco River basin in Venezuela and Colombia, and in the Rio Negro basin in Brazil.

children.name: Acanthodoras spinosissimus
children.description: Acanthodoras spinosissimus, the talking catfish, is a species of thorny catfish found in the Amazon and Essequibo River basins, occurring in Brazil, Colombia, Guyana, and Peru.

children.name: Amblydoras nheco
children.description: Amblydoras nheco is a species of freshwater ray-finned fish, which was described as the only species in the genus Merodoras of the catfish (order Siluriformes) family Doradidae.

children.name: Hassar affinis
children.description: Hassar affinis is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Brazil where it is found in the Parnaiba River basin.

children.name: Hassar wilderi
children.description: Hassar wilderi is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Brazil where it is only found in the Tocantins River basin.

children.name: Hassar orestis
children.description: Hassar orestis is a species of thorny catfish that is native to the countries of Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Peru and Venezuela.

children.name: Oxydoras sifontesi
children.description: Oxydoras sifontesi, the Sierra Copora, is a species of thorny catfish found in the Orinoco River basin in Colombia and Venezuela.

children.name: Oxydoras kneri
children.description: Oxydoras kneri is a species of thorny catfish found in the Paraná River basin in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.

children.name: Doraops zuloagai
children.description: Doraops zuloagai is the only species in the genus Doraops of the catfish (order Siluriformes) family Doradidae.

children.name: Rhynchodoras woodsi
children.description: Rhynchodoras woodsi is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Ecuador where it is found in the Bobonaza River (a tributary of the Pastaza River) of the upper Amazon River drainage.

children.name: Rhynchodoras castilloi
children.description: Rhynchodoras castilloi is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Venezuela where it is found in the middle to lower Apure River.

children.name: Rhynchodoras xingui
children.description: Rhynchodoras xingui is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Brazil where it is found in the upper Xingu River basin.

children.name: Platydoras brachylecis
children.authorship: Piorski, Garavello, Arce H. & Sabaj Pérez, 2008

children.name: Platydoras costatus
children.description: Platydoras costatus, the Raphael catfish, is a species of thorny catfish native to rivers in Brazil, Suriname and French Guiana.

children.name: Kalyptodoras bahiensis
children.description: Kalyptodoras bahiensis is the only species in the genus Kalyptodoras of the catfish (order Siluriformes) family Doradidae.

children.name: Rhinodoras gallagheri
children.description: Rhinodoras gallagheri is a species of thorny catfish known from Apure River, Capanaparo River, and Arauca River, all left bank tributaries of the middle Orinoco, in the llanos regions of Apure and Barinas States of Venezuela.

children.name: Rhinodoras thomersoni
children.description: Rhinodoras thomersoni is a species of thorny catfish native to Colombia and Venezuela where it is found in the river basins along the southwest shore of Lake Maracaibo (Santa Ana, Catatumbo and Escalante Rivers).

children.name: Rhinodoras boehlkei
children.description: Rhinodoras boehlkei is a species of thorny catfish found in the upper Amazon basin of Ecuador and Peru.

children.name: Nemadoras cristinae
children.authorship: Sabaj Pérez, Arce H., Sousa & Birindelli, 2014

children.name: Nemadoras humeralis
children.description: Nemadoras humeralis is a species of thorny catfish native to the Amazon basin where it can be found in Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru.

children.name: Physopyxis lyra
children.description: Physopyxis lyra is a species of thorny catfish found in the Essequibo and Amazon basins.

children.name: Physopyxis ananas
children.description: Physopyxis ananas is a species of thorny catfish found in the lowlands of the Essequibo and Amazon basins.

children.name: Physopyxis cristata
children.description: Physopyxis cristata is a species of thorny catfish endemic to Brazil where it is found in the Rio Negro basin.

children.name: Centrochir crocodili
children.description: Centrochir crocodili is a species of catfish (order Siluriformes) in the family Doradidae.

children.name: Orinocodoras eigenmanni
children.description: Orinocodoras eigenmanni is the only species in the genus Orinocodoras of the catfish (order Siluriformes) family Doradidae.

children.name: Pterodoras granulosus
children.description: The granulated catfish (Pterodoras granulosus) is a species of thorny catfish found in the Paraná and Amazon basin as well as the coastal drainages of Suriname and Guyana.

children.name: Pterodoras rivasi
children.description: Pterodoras rivasi is a species of thorny catfish found in the Orinoco River basin of Colombia and Venezuela.

children.name: Wertheimeria maculata
children.description: Wertheimeria maculata is the only species in the genus Wertheimeria of the catfish (order Siluriformes) family Doradidae.
